{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute raw conversion rates by channel
raw_conversion_rates = df_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
raw_difference = raw_conversion_rates['email'] - raw_conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Print raw difference
print(f'Raw conversion rate (email): {raw_conversion_rates["email"]}')
print(f'Raw conversion rate (paid_search): {raw_conversion_rates["paid_search"]}')
print(f'Raw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_difference}')"}
